protocol.timer: wall clock — time.monotonic seconds around the faber process (benchmark-method §4.3)
protocol.route: faber run — MIR runner, interpreted, package route (telemetry off; the product path carries the number, gpu-lessons L2)
protocol.stdout: captured per sample to observe each case's value-check line (one line per run)
protocol.throughput_law: t/s = (K × units_per_iteration) / min(sample wall, cap_s), median across samples (goal §Perf-taxonomy)
protocol.cap_law: cap_s is a safety circuit breaker only — never a metric, never pass/fail; a capped sample records its valid t/s plus capped=true
